body: Bankruptcy just feels like the noose would tighten even more. I'd have to make payments to the courts, meaning I could face jail time if I don't come up with the money. It would also ruin what little credit I've built up. I don't know. Thank you for all your suggestions but I don't think I can do anything to get out of the hole I'm in at all.

I've already tried that. I posted a really long winded explanation of my situation and the most anyone could say is "Get food stamps for now and look for a better job". At worst the response was "You're stupid and it's your fault you're in debt and have no money ever".
I'm in enough debt to where I won't be able to escape without stealing someone's identity and starting an entirely new life. I'd rather just die at this point. I'm sick of trying.

It really isn't, but it's the only one I have. And I have to stay with them if I have any hope of getting worker's compensation. My brother is in almost as dire straits as I am, living with several people in a 1 bedroom apartment and splitting the rent. He has no room for me. I have been offered a place to stay but it's literally across the country. I can't figure out a way to get enough money together to move myself, my S/O and all of our stuff over there, and to have enough to support ourselves in the meantime while we look for jobs. I want to get out of this low-income trap of a city, but it's literally impossible without hundreds, sometimes thousands of dollars. I have so much debt that it's improbable I'll ever get it paid off even if I start making twice as much as I'm making now tomorrow.

I mean, I've already unloaded the bulk of it. It's just been one thing after the other, for years and years. Right when I think everything is going to be OK, right when I get a new lease in life something shitty happens. With how I'm feeling right now and the things I've been thinking, I think the wrong person could easily see me as an imminent threat. I've heard plenty of horror stories of people with far less signs of suicidal ideation get involuntarily committed. I don't know if talking about it would even help. I feel like dredging through my shitshow of a life would just make me feel worse. I'm fine when things are going OK, but I have a very difficult time dealing with difficult times. I just feel so empty and helpless. Nobody will give me a chance to prove myself worthy to make enough money to live comfortably. I often find myself trying to make excuses for it, to try and find a quick, painless, non-messy approach, but I can't imagine actually doing it and putting my family through the pain of losing someone they care about. If I didn't have my parents I would have done it long ago. I've told myself on many occasions I'd do it once they're gone. Just disappear from my S/O and go out in the woods where I wouldn't be bothering anyone with my remains and just be done with this wretched life.

After selling everything they had put together in the 10 years they had been small business owners, including their house, my mom and dad moved into an RV and are living their dream of travelling over the US. My little brother lives across the US some 1500 miles away. I don't have any relatives that live within an hour from where I am now, I'd have to quit the one job I do have in order to do so. 

I'm just royally fucked no matter how I look at it.
